decision.scope: Offline comparison of one training-sampler knob on a new confirmation exam. All six fits are unconditional after instrument checks; no replacement draws, optional rechecks, sample expansion, or changed bars. GO only permits registering a later flight study, never promotion. Paired rollout-bootstrap intervals condition on fixed checkpoints, not training randomness.
